name: xcp_d
description: XCP-D: Postprocessing Workflow of fMRI Data v26.1.1

inputs.description: The root folder of fMRI preprocessing derivatives. For example, '/path/to/dset/derivatives/fmriprep'.
inputs.name: fmri_dir

inputs.description: The output path for XCP-D derivatives. If the output layout is "multiverse", "xcp_d" will be appended to output_dir, with a hash built from the configuration. For example, setting output_dir to "/path/to/dset/derivatives" and output_layout to "multiverse" will result in the output directory being "/path/to/dset/derivatives/xcp_d-<hash>".If the output layout is "bids", "xcp_d" will not be appended to output_dir. For example, setting output_dir to "/path/to/dset/derivatives/xcp_d" and output_layout to "bids" will result in the output directory being "/path/to/dset/derivatives/xcp_d".
inputs.name: output_dir

inputs.description: The analysis level for XCP-D. Must be specified as 'participant'.
inputs.name: analysis_level

inputs.description: The mode of operation for XCP-D. The mode sets several parameters, with values specific to different pipelines. For more information, see the documentation at https://xcp-d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflows.html#modes. the parameters manually.
inputs.name: mode

inputs.description: A space-delimited list of participant identifiers, or a single identifier. The "sub-" prefix can be removed.
inputs.name: participant_label

inputs.description: A space-delimited list of session identifiers, or a single identifier. The "ses-" prefix can be removed. By default, all sessions will be postprocessed.
inputs.name: session_id

inputs.description: A space-delimited list of task identifiers, or a single identifier. The "task-" prefix can be removed. By default, all tasks will be postprocessed.
inputs.name: task_id

inputs.description: A JSON file describing custom BIDS input filters using PyBIDS. For further details, please check out https://xcp-d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/usage.html#filtering-inputs-with-bids-filter-files
inputs.name: bids_filter_file

inputs.description: Search PATH(s) for derivatives or atlas datasets. These may be provided as named folders (e.g., `--datasets smriprep=/path/to/smriprep`).
inputs.name: datasets

inputs.description: Path to a PyBIDS database folder, for faster indexing (especially useful for large datasets). Will be created if not present.
inputs.name: bids_database_dir

inputs.description: Maximum number of threads across all processes. (Default: 2)
inputs.name: nprocs

inputs.description: Maximum number of threads per process. (Default: 1)
inputs.name: omp_nthreads

inputs.description: Upper bound memory limit, in megabytes, for XCP-D processes.
inputs.name: mem_mb

inputs.description: Attempt to reduce memory usage (will increase disk usage in working directory). IMPORTANT: At the moment, this option has no effect.
inputs.name: low_mem

inputs.description: Nipype plugin configuration file. For more information, see https://nipype.readthedocs.io/en/0.11.0/users/plugins.html.
inputs.name: use_plugin

inputs.description: Increases log verbosity for each occurrence. Debug level is '-vvv'.
inputs.name: verbose

inputs.description: The pipeline used to generate the preprocessed derivatives. The default pipeline is 'fmriprep'. The 'dcan', 'hcp', 'nibabies', and 'ukb' pipelines are also supported. 'nibabies' assumes the same structure as 'fmriprep'.
inputs.name: input_type

inputs.description: The file format of the input data. If 'auto', the file format will be inferred from the processing mode. If 'cifti', the input data are assumed to be in CIFTI format. If 'nifti', the input data are assumed to be in NIfTI format. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: file_format

inputs.description: Number of volumes to remove from the beginning of each run. If set to 'auto', XCP-D will extract non-steady-state volume indices from the preprocessing derivatives' confounds file. (Default: 0)
inputs.name: dummy_scans

inputs.description: Despike the BOLD data before postprocessing. If not provided, the despike option will be inferred from the 'mode'. If provided without an argument, despiking will be enabled. If provided with an argument (y or n), the value of the argument will be used. 'y' enables despiking. 'n' disables despiking. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: despike

inputs.description: Nuisance parameters to be selected. This may be a string indicating one of XCP-D's built-in nuisance regression strategies (e.g., '36P') or a path to a YAML file formatted according to XCP-D's confound configuration file format. Descriptions of each of the built-in options are included in XCP-D's documentation. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: nuisance_regressors

inputs.description: Full-width at half maximum (FWHM), in millimeters, of the Gaussian smoothing kernel to apply to the denoised BOLD data. Set to 0 to disable smoothing. The default value is "auto", which uses the default smoothing value for the processing mode. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: smoothing

inputs.description: After denoising, concatenate each derivative from each task across runs. If not provided, the combine_runs option will be inferred from the processing mode. If provided without an argument, concatenation will be enabled. If provided with an argument (y or n), the value of the argument will be used. 'y' enables concatenation. 'n' disables concatenation. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: combine_runs

inputs.description: Skip specific outputs during postprocessing. Options include: 'alff' (skip ALFF calculation), 'reho' (skip ReHo calculation), 'parcellation' (skip parcellation and time series extraction), 'connectivity' (skip functional connectivity calculations). Multiple options can be specified. Note: Skipping 'parcellation' will also skip 'connectivity'. Skipping 'connectivity' alone will still perform parcellation to extract time series, but will not compute correlation matrices. Skipping 'alff' is only relevant when bandpass filtering is enabled.
inputs.name: skip

inputs.description:
Type of filter to use for removing respiratory artifact from motion regressors.
If not set, no filter will be applied.

If the filter type is set to "notch", then both ``band-stop-min`` and ``band-stop-max``
must be defined.
If the filter type is set to "lp", then only ``band-stop-min`` must be defined.
If the filter type is set to "none", then no filter will be applied.
inputs.name: motion_filter_type

inputs.description:
Lower frequency for the motion parameter filter, in breaths-per-minute (bpm).
Motion filtering is only performed if ``motion-filter-type`` is not None.
If used with the "lp" ``motion-filter-type``, this parameter essentially corresponds to a
low-pass filter (the maximum allowed frequency in the filtered data).
This parameter is used in conjunction with ``motion-filter-order`` and ``band-stop-max``.

When ``motion-filter-type`` is set to "lp" (low-pass filter), another commonly-used value for
this parameter is 6 BPM (equivalent to 0.1 Hertz), based on Gratton et al. (2020).
inputs.name: band_stop_min

inputs.description:
Upper frequency for the band-stop motion filter, in breaths-per-minute (bpm).
Motion filtering is only performed if ``motion-filter-type`` is not None.
This parameter is only used if ``motion-filter-type`` is set to "notch".
This parameter is used in conjunction with ``motion-filter-order`` and ``band-stop-min``.
inputs.name: band_stop_max

inputs.description: Number of filter coefficients for the motion parameter filter. If the motion filter type is 'lp', the order is divided by 2 as filtfilt applies the filter twice. If the motion filter type is 'notch', the order is divided by 4 as iirnotch is a second-order filter and filtfilt applies the filter twice. Make sure to set this parameter to a multiple of 2 if you choose the 'lp' filter and a multiple of 4 if you choose the 'notch' filter. (Default: 4)
inputs.name: motion_filter_order

inputs.description: Head radius used to calculate framewise displacement, in mm. The default value is 50 mm, which is recommended for adults. For infants, we recommend a value of 35 mm. A value of 'auto' is also supported, in which case the brain radius is estimated from the preprocessed brain mask by treating the mask as a sphere. The auto option typically results in a higher estimate than the default. (Default: 50)
inputs.name: head_radius

inputs.description: Framewise displacement (FD) threshold for censoring, in mm. Any volumes with an FD value greater than the threshold will be removed from the denoised BOLD data. A threshold of <=0 will disable censoring completely. The default value is "auto", which uses the default FD threshold for the processing mode. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: fd_thresh

inputs.description:
Post-scrubbing threshold to apply to individual runs in the dataset.
This threshold determines the minimum amount of time, in seconds,
needed to post-process a given run, once high-motion outlier volumes are removed.
This will have no impact if scrubbing is disabled
(i.e., if the FD threshold is zero or negative).
This parameter can be disabled by providing a zero or a negative value.

The default is 240 (4 minutes). (Default: 240)
inputs.name: min_time

inputs.description: The type of output to generate. If 'auto', the output type will be inferred from the processing mode. If 'censored', the BOLD outputs (dense and parcellated time series) will be censored. If 'interpolated', the BOLD outputs (dense and parcellated time series) will be interpolated. This parameter has no effect on correlation matrix outputs. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: output_type

inputs.description: Disable bandpass filtering. If bandpass filtering is disabled, then ALFF derivatives will not be calculated.
inputs.name: disable_bandpass_filter

inputs.description: Lower cut-off frequency (Hz) for the Butterworth bandpass filter to be applied to the denoised BOLD data. Set to 0.0 or negative to disable high-pass filtering. See Satterthwaite et al. (2013). (Default: 0.01)
inputs.name: lower_bpf

inputs.description: Upper cut-off frequency (Hz) for the Butterworth bandpass filter to be applied to the denoised BOLD data. Set to 0.0 or negative to disable low-pass filtering. See Satterthwaite et al. (2013). (Default: 0.08)
inputs.name: upper_bpf

inputs.description: Number of filter coefficients for the Butterworth bandpass filter. (Default: 2)
inputs.name: bpf_order

inputs.description: Coverage threshold to apply to parcels in each atlas. Any parcels with lower coverage than the threshold will be replaced with NaNs. Must be a value between zero and one, indicating proportion of the parcel. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: min_coverage

inputs.description: Output run-wise correlation matrices. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: output_run_wise_correlations

inputs.description:
If used, this parameter will produce correlation matrices limited to each requested amount of time
from the concatenated BOLD data.
If there is more than the required amount of low-motion data,
then volumes will be randomly selected to produce correlation matrices with the exact
amounts of time requested.
If there is less than the required amount of 'good' data,
then the corresponding correlation matrix will not be produced.

This option requires that `--combine-runs` be enabled.
If run concatenation is not enabled, using this option will raise an error.

This option is not supported in the "linc" mode.
inputs.name: create_matrices

inputs.description: Initialize the random seed for the '--create-matrices' option.
inputs.name: random_seed

inputs.description:
Run LINC QC.

This will calculate QC metrics from the LINC pipeline. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: linc_qc

inputs.description:
Run ABCC QC.

This will create the DCAN executive summary, including a brainsprite visualization of the
anatomical tissue segmentation, and an HDF5 file containing motion levels at different thresholds. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: abcc_qc

inputs.description: Where should the html reports be written? "root" will write them to the --output-dir. "subject" will write them into each subject's directory. "session" will write them into each session's directory. The default is "auto", which will default to "root" for "none", "linc", and "nichart" modes, and "session" for "abcd" and "hbcd" modes.
inputs.name: report_output_level

inputs.description: Maximum number of sessions aggregated in one subject's visual report. If exceeded, visual reports are split by session. (Default: 4)
inputs.name: aggregate_session_reports

inputs.description: Output layout for the BOLD data. If "bids", the output will be in BIDS format, similar to fMRIPrep output. If "multiverse", "xcp_d" will be appended to output_dir, with a hash built from the configuration. (Default: "bids")
inputs.name: output_layout

inputs.description: Path to working directory, where intermediate results should be stored.
inputs.name: work_dir

inputs.description: Clears working directory of contents. Use of this flag is not recommended when running concurrent processes of XCP-D.
inputs.name: clean_workdir

inputs.description: Enable Nipype's resource monitoring to keep track of memory and CPU usage.
inputs.name: resource_monitor

inputs.description: Use pre-generated configuration file. Values in file will be overridden by command-line arguments.
inputs.name: config_file

inputs.description: Write workflow graph.
inputs.name: write_graph

inputs.description: Force stopping on first crash, even if a work directory was specified.
inputs.name: stop_on_first_crash

inputs.description: Opt out of sending tracking information.
inputs.name: notrack

inputs.description: Debug mode(s) to enable. 'all' is alias for all available modes.
inputs.name: debug

inputs.description: Path to FreeSurfer license key file. Get it (for free) by registering at https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/registration.html. This is not currently required, but may be in the future.
inputs.name: fs_license_file

inputs.description: Skip generation of HTML and LaTeX formatted citation with pandoc
inputs.name: md_only_boilerplate

inputs.description: generate boilerplate only
inputs.name: boilerplate_only

inputs.description: only generate reports, don't run workflows. This will only rerun report aggregation, not reportlet generation for specific nodes.
inputs.name: reports_only

inputs.description:
If used, a workflow will be run to warp native-space (``fsnative``) reconstructed cortical
surfaces (``surf.gii`` files) produced by Freesurfer into standard (``fsLR``) space.
Additionally, the fsLR-space surfaces will be warped such that they can be overlaid on the
MNI152NLin6Asym template.
These surface files are primarily used for visual quality assessment.

**IMPORTANT**: This parameter can only be run if the --file-format flag is set to cifti. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: warp_surfaces_native2std
